items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: But I had an actor with me that blew up balloons, Barney and John Shirley.

ctx.x: What kind of a reception did you get?

Oh just great. Well drums is a language over there, you know, and so you had it halfway made then. But I had an actor with me that blew up balloons, Barney and John Shirley. He could make different balloons, all different kind of animals. They were just terrific. Then I had a singing act, I had a Mistress of Ceremonies with me by the name of Mildred Clinton. She used to go with me on these interviews. She spoke French fluently, and she was a great help. Then I had a family of three, the Riches. He played drums…
So I guess the reception must have been very good.
